name: fastapi
description: FastAPI + Pydantic + SQLAlchemy/async ORM. Targets developers building HTTP APIs, LLM-backed services, or async data ingestion endpoints in Python. The foundation rules and workflow are kept; clearly non-applicable skills are filtered out: frontend-only stacks (Next.js, Shadcn, React perf, frontend design), mobile stacks (Flutter, mobile-release), homelab-specific ops (Proxmox, OPNsense), and UI-bound QA (Chrome, design, browser E2E). Skills that ARE kept and useful for backend work include `dev-api`, `dev-auth`, `dev-graphql`, `dev-supabase` (Python SDK), `ops-database`, `ops-docker`, `ops-monitoring`, `qa-perf`, `qa-security`. Bundles ZERO marketplace plugins at v1 — Python-specific plugin curation will be added incrementally as each one is validated in real production use, not assumed.

recommendedVendorSkills.rationale: Postgres best practices (30 rules) + Supabase Python SDK patterns
MongoDB schema design, indexing, query patterns, operational safeguards
Grafana, LGTM stack (Loki/Tempo/Mimir), k6 perf testing

outOfScope: Frontend rendering — pair with the nextjs preset, or community presets for Astro/SvelteKit/Vue/Nuxt when shipped
Mobile / desktop apps (community contributions wanted for flutter, swift, tauri)
Authentication strategy choice — FastAPI has many viable patterns (JWT, OAuth2, fastapi-users, Authlib); the foundation does not pick one
Container orchestration beyond docker-compose — Kubernetes patterns belong to a future k8s preset
Backends in other languages — see roadmap for Django, Flask, Rails, Spring Boot, Gin, Axum

Toolchain choice (uv vs pdm vs pip, ruff vs flake8, ty vs mypy) — see docs/recipes/python-toolchain-options.md for the three documented paths and the rationale for not bundling astral@astral-sh by default
